name: Serena Mandla
title: CSO & Co-Founder @ Noa Therapeutics
bio:
Serena Mandla, P.Eng., MASc., is the Chief Scientific Officer & Co-Founder of Noa Therapeutics, a preclinical biotech company based in JLABS pioneering the development of novel biased small molecule therapeutics to reestablish innate immune equilibrium for diseases such as atopic dermatitis and IBD/ulcerative colitis. At Noa Therapeutics, Serena leads the Research and Development team and their efforts to advance their first product into the clinic, while expanding their drug discovery efforts to identify novel small molecule compounds.

Prior to Noa Therapeutics, Serena was involved in a spin-out from her MASc in Biomedical Engineering from the University of Toronto, Quthero Inc., where she has successfully raised financing and commercialized products for accelerating skin repair. She has over 15 scientific papers from her research at the University of Toronto and Harvard and is passionate about translating research into the clinic, developing new technologies and treatments.

Outside of work, Serena is avidly involved as a mentor with underrepresented scientific youth through the U of T Alumni Mentorship Program and the Canadian Biomaterials Society, has delivered talks on entrepreneurship at Queen’s University, Western University, and the University of Toronto, and was recently awarded the Engineering Medal – Young Engineer by OSPE.

name: Feyisayo (Feyi) Enuiyin
title: Founder @ Deus Nobiscum Inc.
bio: Feyisayo (“Feyi”) Enuiyin is a Chemical Engineering graduate and product strategist with corporate experience across RBC, Bell, and Geotab. She has supported large-scale digital product initiatives, mobile platform development, and enterprise software delivery for global users, bringing a strong operator mindset to every role. Alongside her corporate experience, Feyi has built a strong presence in the Canadian tech ecosystem through her involvement with The Firehood, Toronto Tech Fest, and other community-driven innovation programs. She is a budding angel investor through The Firehood Angels, engaging with early-stage deal flow and supporting women-led and emerging-tech founders.
